# Tagged <a class="source-link ignore-header" href="https://github.com/example/tagged/blob/main/src/init.luau#L1" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="View source"></a>

rendered page. See [`Widget`](/api/Widget) and [`Promise`](https://eryn.io/roblox-lua-promise/lib/) for prose links.
